rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 4AA label, but it overstates image-confirmable details such as a clearly cohesive TE and specific cellular features; the image mainly supports an expanded/hatching blastocyst with a compact ICM.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, prior failed cycle, sperm factors, and endometrium well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The assessment is logically structured and the prognosis generally follows from embryo quality and patient factors, though a few claims (e.g., stress effects, exact euploidy implications) are presented with more certainty than warranted.

eSET for a good-quality blastocyst in a 31-year-old is guideline-concordant, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, strong endorsement of PGT-A after one failed cycle, and ERA after limited failure are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, but some recommendations would benefit from more nuance regarding indications and evidence strength.
